simple.prompt: Look at those dark storm clouds! It ___ rain very soon.
simple.explanation: Ketika ada bukti fisik nyata yang terlihat saat ini (present evidence seperti awan gelap), gunakan 'be going to' untuk prediksi: 'It is going to rain'.
hints: Ada bukti fisik yang jelas terlihat di depan mata.
Gunakan 'be going to' untuk prediksi berbasis bukti nyata.

simple.prompt: The telephone is ringing! — Don't worry, I ___ answer it.
simple.explanation: Keputusan spontan yang dibuat pada saat berbicara (spontaneous on-the-spot decision) menggunakan modal 'will': 'I will answer it'.
hints: Keputusan mendadak dibuat seketika saat itu juga.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat rencana masa depan yang sudah diniatkan (prior intention).
simple.targetSentence: We are going to launch the website next week.
simple.explanation: Subject (We) + are going to + base verb (launch) + the website + next week.
hints: Rencana yang sudah diniatkan sebelum berbicara.

simple.prompt: I promise I ___ reveal your confidential project details to anyone.
simple.explanation: Janji (promises), tawaran (offers), dan ancaman (threats) menggunakan modal 'will' atau bentuk negatifnya 'won't'.

simple.targetSentence: I will carry those heavy boxes for you.
simple.explanation: Tawaran bantuan spontan: I will + carry + those heavy boxes + for you.

simple.prompt: She has already bought her flight tickets; she ___ spend her vacation in Bali.
simple.explanation: Karena tiket sudah dibeli (ada persiapan dan rencana matang), gunakan 'be going to': 'is going to spend'.
hints: Rencana yang sudah dipersiapkan dan diniatkan sebelumnya.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya rencana dengan 'Are you going to'.
simple.targetSentence: Are you going to attend the seminar tomorrow?
simple.explanation: Are you going to + base verb (attend) + the seminar + tomorrow?

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di restoran yang menunjukkan keputusan spontan.
dialogue: Are you ready to order, sir?
Yes, I ___ have the grilled salmon and a sparkling water, please.
intermediate.explanation: Pemesanan makanan di restoran adalah keputusan spontan saat membaca menu, sehingga menggunakan 'will': 'I will have...'.

intermediate.prompt: In my opinion, renewable energy ___ replace fossil fuels within the next two decades.
intermediate.explanation: Prediksi berdasarkan opini pribadi atau keyakinan subjektif (personal belief/opinion setelah 'In my opinion' atau 'I think') biasanya memakai 'will'.
hints: Prediksi berbasis opini atau keyakinan subjektif.

intermediate.prompt: Watch out! That unstable stack of crates ___ topple over!
intermediate.explanation: Peringatan darurat berdasarkan kejadian fisik yang sedang berlangsung saat itu (immediate visible evidence) menggunakan 'is going to'.
hints: Tanda-tanda fisik sudah terlihat bergoyang mau jatuh.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat janji formal dengan 'will never'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We will never compromise on data security.
intermediate.explanation: Janji formal: We will never + compromise on + data security.

intermediate.prompt: ___ we organize a farewell dinner for the departing project manager?
intermediate.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris baku, 'Shall I / Shall we...?' digunakan untuk menawarkan saran atau usulan sopan (suggestions/offers with I/we).
hints: Saran atau tawaran sopan dengan subjek 'we'.

intermediate.targetSentence: The printer won't print this document.
intermediate.explanation: 'Won't' dapat digunakan untuk benda yang menolak berfungsi (refusal of an object): 'The car won't start / The printer won't print'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih bentuk rencana terkonfirmasi vs keputusan seketika.
dialogue: Why are you packing up your files?
Because I ___ clean out my desk before relocating tomorrow.
intermediate.explanation: Rencana yang sudah diniatkan sebelum ditanya (prior plan/intention) menggunakan 'am going to clean'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan penggunaan 'will' di dalam klausa waktu (time clause).
complex.draft: As soon as the client will arrive, we will start the product walkthrough.
options: As soon as the client arrives, we will start the product walkthrough.
As soon as the client is arriving, we will start the product walkthrough.
As soon as the client arrived, we will start the product walkthrough.
complex.explanation: Di dalam klausa waktu yang diawali konjungsi seperti 'as soon as', 'when', 'before', 'after', atau 'until', TIDAK boleh menggunakan 'will'. Wajib menggunakan Present Simple ('arrives') untuk menyatakan waktu masa depan.
hints: Klausa waktu (as soon as, when, before) tidak boleh memakai 'will'.
Gunakan Present Simple di dalam klausa waktunya.

complex.prompt: If the audit team ___ any irregularities, they will notify executive management immediately.
complex.explanation: Dalam First Conditional (If-clause), klausa 'if' menggunakan Present Simple ('discovers'), bukan 'will'.

complex.prompt: The train ___ at precisely 08:45 tomorrow morning according to the official timetable.
complex.explanation: Untuk jadwal transportasi umum atau agenda resmi yang sudah tertera di jadwal tetap (timetables/schedules), bahasa Inggris formal menggunakan Present Simple ('departs'), bukan 'will'.
hints: Jadwal transportasi resmi menggunakan Present Simple.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat klausa waktu masa depan dengan konjungsi 'until'.
complex.targetSentence: We will wait here until you return.
complex.explanation: Main clause (We will wait here) + Time clause (until you return). Di klausa 'until' gunakan Present Simple 'return'.
hints: Main clause memakai 'We will wait here'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kerancuan penggunaan modal masa depan pada klausa 'unless'.
complex.draft: We cannot finalize the deal unless the vendor will agree to the terms.
options: We cannot finalize the deal unless the vendor agrees to the terms.
We cannot finalize the deal unless the vendor is agreeing to the terms.
We cannot finalize the deal unless the vendor will be agreeing to the terms.
complex.explanation: Sama seperti 'if', konjungsi syarat 'unless' (jika tidak) tidak boleh diikuti 'will'. Gunakan Present Simple: 'unless the vendor agrees'.
hints: Gunakan Present Simple: 'unless the vendor agrees'.

complex.prompt: The international trade conference ___ take place next October in Singapore.
complex.explanation: Struktur formal resmi 'be to + infinitive' ('is to take place') digunakan dalam konteks berita, diplomatik, atau instruksi resmi untuk peristiwa masa depan yang sudah dijadwalkan secara kenegaraan/resmi.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi dengan janji bersyarat yang gramatikal.
dialogue: When can we expect the milestone payment?
We will issue the disbursement the moment the shipment ___ our warehouse.
complex.explanation: Frasa waktu 'the moment...' berfungsi sebagai konjungsi waktu (seperti as soon as), sehingga klausa berikutnya harus menggunakan Present Simple: 'reaches'.
hints: 'The moment' adalah konjungsi waktu penanda saat.
